mentions.name: old-agent
mentions.description: This project provides sysadmin AI agents that run on machines 30 years old, written entirely in legacy Perl. It supports legacy operating systems such as HP-UX, OpenStep, Solaris 8, Tru64, Irix, old Linux, and legacy FreeBSD/NetBSD, includes an optional Tk desktop interface, and ships a proxy for modern TLS.
mentions.problem: Modern AI tooling doesn't run on decades-old machines and legacy operating systems.
mentions.audience: System administrators managing legacy Unix machines
mentions.source_excerpt:
Sysadmin agents on old machines.

Run AI on machines 30 years old.

Entirely in legacy Perl.

HP-UX, OpenStep, Solaris 8, Tru64, Irix, old Linux. Legacy FreeBSD, NetBSD...

Optional desktop in tk.

There's even a proxy for modern tls.
mentions.author: kristopolous
